t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes appear in the same colour pairs. He believes the gnomes give more points depending on the side they appear on, but they change around. He also believes there could be a correlation between how much they give and how many times they appear in a row. He advises to test the gnomes payout only on x1 multipliers.

vb_textbox.text: It seems as though brown, purple, blue, and red gnomes pay out more. Especially when they are on the left hand side during a 5x multiplier. If the gnome isn't brown, purple, blue, or red during a 5x multiplier the right hand side seems to pay out more. There may be some correlation with hats, too. I found the pointy hat gnomes tended to pay most.
